blocks.html: It’s the Robinsons Malls Giant Sale

Savvy shoppers mark your calendars this October as we roll out the biggest sale of the year --- Robinsons Malls Giant Sale. Running nationwide, Robinsons Malls' Giant Sale the perfect time to schedule that much needed retail therapy or early Christmas shopping and get discounts of up to 70%. Get a load of special markdowns on fashionable apparel to accessories, toys, home decor --- from October 15-18 for all Robinsons Malls . Robinsons Malls' patrons can also get a load of shopping from October 30-31 at Robinsons Place Santiago. There also fun activities that will be happening during the sale dates : the Zumba Giant Party at Robinsons Place Pangasinan on October 16 and the ABS CBN Audition Caravan on October 17-18 in Robinsons Place Palawan. Enjoy performances by Jay-Ar on October 15 in Robinsons Place Pangasinan, Zsa Zsa Padilla on October 16 in Robinsons Place Las Piñas, MYMP on October 18 in Robinsons Forum, Hale on October 17 is Robinsons Place Dasmariñas and the Voice Kids Season 2 finalists in Robinsons Place Imus, Robinson Place Antipolo and Robinsons Place Lipa.
The sale will be extend to November 8 for Robinsons Galleria, Robinsons Magnolia and Robinsons Place Manila in support of the Philippine Shopping Festival (ShopFest 2015) organized by the Philippine Retailers Association (PRA) and the Department of Tourism – Tourism Promotions Board..
For more exciting news on Robinsons Malls events and promos, visit www.robinsonsmalls.com.
